source.publisher: Parker English 怕渴英文（TOEIC 聽力模擬試題）
source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

lines.en: 1. How will I recognize their staff members?
lines.zh: 1. 我要怎麼認出他們的工作人員？

lines.en: (A) They were very helpful.
(B) They'll be wearing badges.
(C) They have been stacked in the corner.
2. Did you pay for your hotel for the convention?
lines.zh: 2. 參加大會的飯店錢是你自己付的嗎？

lines.en: (A) My company usually covers that.
(B) We only take credit cards.
(C) A convention about digital media.
lines.zh: (C) 一場關於數位媒體的大會。

lines.en: 3. Why did you get back from your trip so early?
lines.zh: 3. 你出差怎麼這麼早就回來了？

lines.en: (A) Because I tripped and fell.
(B) I'll be taking the train.
(C) The meeting ended earlier than expected.
4. Should we buy a one-way ticket or get a round trip?
lines.zh: 4. 我們要買單程票還是來回票？

lines.en: (A) I had a great trip.
(B) Right here at the ticket counter.
(C) We'll have to come back on the same day.
5. Doesn't Mr. Norton work in the Personnel Department?
lines.zh: 5. Norton 先生不是在人事部工作嗎？

lines.en: (A) Yes, he just confirmed his departure time.
lines.zh: (A) 是的，他剛確認了出發時間。

lines.en: (B) No, he retired two weeks ago.
(C) No, I prefer to walk there.
6. Are you planning to go to the time management seminar?
lines.zh: 6. 你打算去參加時間管理研討會嗎？

lines.en: (A) Yes, and I learned a lot.
(B) No, I'm taking the subway.
(C) Yes, it sounds interesting.
7. How will the machinery be transported to Argentina?
lines.zh: 7. 機器要怎麼運到阿根廷？

lines.en: (A) Based on the size of the factory.
(B) The most efficient means is by ship.
lines.zh: (B) 最有效率的方式是海運。

lines.en: (C) Automatically packing boxes and cartons with machines.
8. How often do you update this software?
lines.zh: 8. 這套軟體多久更新一次？

lines.en: (A) Not unless a bug is found.
lines.zh: (A) 除非發現錯誤，否則不更新。

lines.en: (B) Of course we do.
(C) Usually by ourselves.
9. What did you include in the job advertisement?
lines.zh: 9. 你在徵才廣告裡寫了哪些內容？

lines.en: (A) We received over 200 résumés.
lines.zh: (A) 我們收到兩百多份履歷。

lines.en: (B) The minimum requirement is a high school diploma.
(C) Everything except for the salary.
10. Are you able to stay late tonight to help set up?
lines.zh: 10. 你今晚能留晚一點幫忙布置嗎？

lines.en: (A) Yes, this headset will be on display.
lines.zh: (A) 是的，這款耳機會展示出來。

lines.en: (B) It's still not too late to sign up.
(C) Yes, for an extra hour or two.
11. Why does Patricia want to change shifts with you tomorrow?
lines.zh: 11. Patricia 為什麼想和你換明天的班？

lines.en: (A) A change would be good for her.
(B) Because she tried to shift the blame to someone else.
lines.zh: (B) 因為她想把責任推給別人。

lines.en: (C) She has an unexpected meeting with a client.
12. How many people are expected to attend the trade fair?
lines.zh: 12. 預計有多少人參加商展？

lines.en: (A) Over 200, I guess.
(B) One of the speakers can't make it.
(C) I believe it's not fair to him.
13. When will the inspection team finally get their hands on our new equipment for testing?
lines.zh: 13. 檢驗小組到底什麼時候才會拿到我們的新設備去測試？

lines.en: (A) The inspector is absent for some reason.
(B) The result turned out to be quite unexpected.
(C) I don't have even the slightest clue.
14. What's the best way to the city hall?
(A) Try taking Oxford Street.
(B) Around twenty dollars per ticket.
(C) The guided tour starts at two o'clock.
15. What is the matter with the new lights?
(A) They were installed over a month ago.
(B) The switch doesn't work properly.
(C) I'm going to get an extension cord.
16. Who's in charge of scheduling employees' work shifts?
(A) Natalie works double shifts.
(B) She said we are far behind schedule.
lines.zh: (B) 她說我們進度嚴重落後。

lines.en: (C) The factory supervisor.
17. Do you want to let Richard know that you dropped by today?
lines.zh: 17. 要不要讓 Richard 知道你今天來過？

lines.en: (A) No, I forgot to tell him.
(B) Sure, I will drop by at three.
(C) That won't be necessary.
18. Maybe we should consider ordering from a different supplier.
lines.zh: 18. 也許我們該考慮跟別的供應商訂貨。

lines.en: (A) No, we don't order from them anymore.
lines.zh: (A) 不，我們已經不跟他們訂了。

lines.en: (B) Two boxes of copy paper.
(C) Okay, I'm open to that.
19. You're going to the training session today, aren't you?
lines.zh: 19. 你今天會去參加訓練課程，對吧？

lines.en: (A) The training is scheduled for today.
(B) Isn't it mandatory?
lines.zh: (B) 那不是規定一定要參加嗎？

lines.en: (C) You must board the train now.
20. Shall we talk it over in the conference room, or would you prefer to stay here?
lines.zh: 20. 我們要去會議室談，還是你想留在這裡？

lines.en: (A) Thanks, I've been waiting all day.
(B) I went to the convention last month.
lines.zh: (B) 我上個月去參加了大會。

lines.en: (C) It's more convenient with the equipment here.
